name: Baxter County, AR
findings: Baxter County has 130 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Baxter County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
